description: Classic 30x30 Snake with a 4-CPU-players mode: continuous movement, growth, wall/self collision, arrow keys, CPU search-for-food, three modes (human vs human, cpu vs human, 4 cpu), live score, start + game-over screens, restart.

criteria: snake4cpu is one self-contained file with a playable 30x30 snake: continuous movement, growth on eating, wall/self collision ends the game, arrow-key controls, a CPU mode that automatically searches for food, the three game modes (human vs human, cpu vs human, and 4 CPU players), a live score, a start menu and a game-over screen, and restart on a keypress.
